mentions.name: rezgen.app
mentions.description: A resume generator that creates ATS-optimized resumes tailored to each parsed job posting. It lets users quickly produce many resumes that follow the same formatting rules and design, eliminating the need to use Word or similar software to keep formatting consistent.
mentions.problem: Ensuring resumes always come out formatted the same typically requires using Word or other software; this tool removes that need.
mentions.source_excerpt: Currently working on rezgen.app which is an resume generator that helps to generate ATS optimized resumes per job posting parsed. It helps so that you can quickly crank out many resumes that all follow the same formatting rules and design.
